shellCommands.command: git status --short && git diff && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | grep -v package-lock | head -100

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx app/news/page.tsx .gitignore; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat $f; echo; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null && node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)"

grep -o "dynamicIO[^,;]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head; grep -o "cacheComponents[^,;]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -3; grep -n "hours\|revalidate: 3600\|revalidate: 60 \* 60" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head; grep -rn "dynamicIO" node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js | head
git status --short; echo ---; git diff tsconfig.json

printf 'node_modules/
__agent_eval__/
.next/
next-env.d.ts
' > .gitignore && (PORT=3123 npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && echo "--- /news" && curl -s localhost:3123/news | grep -o '<main>.*</main>' && echo && echo "--- /preview no cookie" && curl -s localhost:3123/preview | grep -o '<main>.*</main>' | sed 's/<script.*//' | head -c 400 && echo && echo "--- /preview with cookie" && curl -s -H 'Cookie: draft-title=Breaking%3A%20Harbor%20reopens' localhost:3123/preview | grep -o 'Breaking[^<]*' ; pkill -f "next start" ; true

git add -A && git status --short && git commit -q -m "Migrate to Cache Components

Replace experimental.dynamicIO with cacheComponents and drop the route
segment configs it disallows. The newsroom feed keeps its hourly refresh
via 'use cache' + cacheLife('hours'); editor preview keeps its per-request
cookie read inside a Suspense boundary so the route is partially
prerendered instead of opted out.
